pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions with soft, non-serrated edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are significantly larger than those descending toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways forming a network of variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-shaped) and quadri-radial (X-shaped), with pathways widening towards the lower posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dense, short-cropped mane exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the upper neck profile against the sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple symbiotic oxpeckers (birds) clinging to the pelage, specifically on the upper neck/mane area and the base of the tail.
